note: Three short blocks take two first chords from clean shapes to changes on the bar line to strumming every beat, each over a metronome with the chord blocks lit. The text says what to press and what the lit block means, with no fingering talk: the chord boxes show the fingers.

exercise.title: Em to Am, clean and in time
exercise.focus: Em-Am changes · strumming with the metronome at 60 bpm
exercise.why: Em and Am share a finger shape, so they are the easiest first change to make automatic.

items: Press a chord box to hear how the chord should sound.
Fret Em as shown, then pick the strings one at a time to check that each one rings.
Fret Am as shown and check it the same way.
Switch slowly between the two shapes, at your own pace.

sections.text: Press Play below. After a bar of count-in, the lit block shows the chord to play. Strum down once on beat 1 of each bar, and use the rest of the bar to move to the next chord.
Press Play below. Now the chord changes every bar: strum down on every beat. If a change comes late, keep strumming and catch the next beat 1.
